name: Chunk-based Voxel Data Structure
aliases: Chunk-based Voxel Data Structure — Block Storage
definition: Divides an infinite voxel world into fixed-size 3D blocks (chunks) to manage memory and processing locality. Each chunk stores voxel IDs in a flat array.
summary: The Chunk-based Voxel Data Structure organizes 3D voxel grids into fixed-size blocks to enable spatial locality and constant-time access, distinguishing itself from dense grids and sparse octrees by providing a flat, predictable memory layout.
